subject: Important Update: Changes to Your Subscription
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you about some upcoming changes to your subscription plan. Starting next month, there will be a slight increase in the monthly fee due to improved services and additional features. We understand the importance of transparency and wanted to give you advance notice of these adjustments. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for being a loyal subscriber!
